title: VerdictEvent (ZPMND airlock -> RESEARCH GROUP, verdicts/; docs/REGLAS.md rules 21 and 22)
description: What the ZPMND airlock did with one packet, so RG can measure its precision. Fixed lists and patterns only: no free text and no field that carries authority, at any depth. issued_by ZPMND is worth nothing by itself: it counts only with its constancia verified (the Sigstore bundle against the identity of the ZPMND workflow that signed it). That verification in CI is a later PR and does not exist yet; until it does, a VerdictEvent carries no authority into RG (rule 22): nothing in RG reads verdicts/.

packet_id.description: RP-YYYY-MM-DD-slug, the form of every packet in research-packets/ (RP- plus the request id's tail).

verdict.description: The airlock outcomes of RESEARCH_CONTRACT.md section 3.

finding_ids.description: JSON pointers to the findings of that packet the verdict is about (empty: the whole packet).

constancia.description: The Sigstore bundle, under verdicts/, and the certificate identity of the workflow that signed it: one of ZPMND's repository, romerobarcenabraulio-hash/ZPPMND, on main (issued_by names the system; this names its repository).
